actors: 需要续费、下载、客服或公告入口的访问者
as_is_flows.trigger: 用户打开当前全房通首页
steps: 用户识别当前页面品牌和登录入口
用户查看到期提醒和自助续费入口
用户寻找扫码登录、忘记密码、客服联系、客户端下载或公告提示
as_is_flows.observed_state: 当前页面聚合登录、续费、下载、客服和公告类入口，但入口中心定位和响应式信息层级需要被原型化验证
pain_points: 业务入口关系需要更明确
移动端和桌面端的信息优先级需要统一验证
真实后端能力边界必须避免被原型验收混淆

to_be_flows.trigger: 用户进入首页入口中心原型
steps: 用户选择密码、验证码或扫码登录方式
用户查看下载、客服和公告入口
用户在桌面或移动视口下完成同一入口识别
to_be_flows.expected_outcome: 用户能清楚识别入口中心的核心操作和未集成边界，且所有真实能力仅作为 prototype_only/not_integrated 行为展示

business_flows: User opens the homepage entry center prototype, selects a login or auxiliary entry, and observes clear prototype-only feedback.
User reviews the same entry-center hierarchy under desktop and mobile viewport constraints.
user_paths: Password, verification-code, and QR login switching path.
Renewal prompt acknowledgement or collapse path.
Download, support, and announcement entry discovery path.
Desktop and mobile responsive review path.
rule_mappings: RULE-1: PM artifacts may describe WHAT behavior only; design owns layout and implementation decisions.
RULE-2: any real backend, payment, download, support, auth, tracking, release, or rollback capability must be marked prototype_only or not_integrated.

options: login-first layout with auxiliary action rail
task-centered dashboard grouping login, renewal, download, support, and announcement equally
design_decision_candidates.constraints: must preserve prototype_only and not_integrated boundaries while keeping desktop and mobile entry recognition clear
design_decision_candidates.design_handoff: choose layout and interaction states without adding production backend integration

coverage_matrix.action_or_path: open download, support, and announcement entries

technical_evidence_requirements.business_invariant: Prototype interactions must never be interpreted as real login, payment, download, support, backend, auth, tracking, release, or rollback integration.
technical_evidence_requirements.required_downstream_proof: Design, test-design, QA, and signoff must preserve prototype_only or not_integrated markers for all backend-facing behavior.

unsupported_platforms: payment, download, support, telemetry, auth, release, and rollback paths

residual_risks.description: QFT-ASIS evidence pack must exist before final AS-IS claims are accepted.
